subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this gated core Swarm v1 contract—including `tools.swarm`, collector persistence, and the new wait/output tool semantics—as the supported direction now?
rationale: The PR is not merely a local implementation choice: it adds public configuration, gateway fields, persistent state, and an agent orchestration model that future QuickJS and Codex projections will build on.

options.title: Sponsor Swarm v1 with proof
options.body: Accept the frozen v1 direction, contingent on redacted real-runtime and restart-recovery proof plus normal CI resolution.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep only a smaller collector/wait primitive and defer public configuration or structured-output semantics until the product contract is settled.

options.title: Defer core adoption
options.body: Keep the direction tracked in the linked program issue until maintainer capacity and user-facing rollout ownership are available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Swarm v1 with proof
recommendation.body: Accept the frozen v1 direction, contingent on redacted real-runtime and restart-recovery proof plus normal CI resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked program issue and every implementation/follow-up commit identify this contributor as the clearest available owner of the proposed Swarm direction.
